# NSA Cleaning LLC

> NSA Cleaning LLC is an insured house and commercial cleaning company at 321 25th St, Watervliet, NY 12189, serving New York's Capital Region from Albany to Lake George since 2016. Phone (407) 728-0523. Run by Ronie Bublak and Alex Bublak.

- Also known as: NSA Cleaning
- Phone: (407) 728-0523
- Email: Nsacleaningllc@gmail.com
- Website: https://lp.nsacleaningllc.com/
- Google Business Profile: https://maps.google.com/?cid=12610868214912534386
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/nsacleaning
- Hours: residential 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM, Monday to Friday; commercial 24/7
- Languages: English, Portuguese, Spanish
- Prices: recurring house cleaning from $160 per visit for apartments and $195 for houses; supplies and travel included; every other service gets a free quote
- Service area: Albany, Watervliet, Troy, Cohoes, Latham, Colonie, Schenectady, Rensselaer, East Greenbush, Delmar, Guilderland, Clifton Park, Halfmoon, Mechanicville, Ballston Spa, Malta, Saratoga Springs, Wilton, Glens Falls, Queensbury, Lake George (NY), up to about 60 minutes from Watervliet
- Not to be confused with NSA Cleaning Services LLC, a separate company in Illinois and Wisconsin.
